summary.en: Generics and biosimilars drive development, with 40 biosimilar assets reported in Q3. Regulatory streamlining makes conventional Phase 1–3 labels incomplete for several major biosimilar programs.
summary.zh: 仿制药和生物类似药驱动开发,第三季度报告有 40 个生物类似药资产。监管流程简化使得传统的 I–III 期标签对若干主要生物类似药项目并不完整。

ind.zh: HER2 阳性早期/转移性乳腺癌

ind.en: Unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma; other solid tumors
ind.zh: 不可切除肝细胞癌;其他实体瘤

watch.en: Biosimilars represented 34% of Q3 sales and grew 17% at constant currencies; generics were stable.
watch.zh: 生物类似药占第三季度销售额的 34%,按固定汇率计增长 17%;仿制药保持稳定。

watch.en: Sandoz is streamlining biosimilar clinical programs; older Phase 3 labels can misrepresent current development.
watch.zh: Sandoz 正在精简生物类似药临床项目;较早的 III 期标签可能会误示当前的开发状况。

watch.en: Henlius and mAbxience collaborations expanded the pipeline in 2026.
watch.zh: Henlius 和 mAbxience 的合作在 2026 年扩充了管线。

watch.en: Near-term biosimilar supply constraints and German market conditions affected Q3 performance.
watch.zh: 近期生物类似药供应受限和德国市场状况影响了第三季度业绩。

sources: Company Q3 2026 presentation, accessible transcript mirror
gaps: The company Q3 results and investor pages opened without readable body/links. Local curl could not resolve hosts, preventing download fallback. The full Q3 presentation was read on EarningsReport as a mirror; no independent analysis from that site was used.

Every asset also appears in the opened primary FY2025 presentation. This February 2026 source is older than 2026-06; the Q3 presentation mirror confirms continued clinical development and pertuzumab EU submission.

Numeric phases for the five clinical biosimilars were not verified after trial streamlining; phase is null under the missing-field rule rather than inventing a Phase 3 status. No next milestones or dates were verified; next is null.

For pembrolizumab, nivolumab, atezolizumab and ocrelizumab, the primary slides identify therapeutic areas but do not verify exact lead indications, mechanisms or modalities; those fields are null. Pertuzumab modality/target remain unverified and null. Pertuzumab indication and licensed origin come from the opened company license release; ipilimumab licensed origin likewise comes from its company release.

Counts is null because regulatory-review/yet-to-launch, clinical, technical and early-development buckets do not constitute company-published Phase 1/2/3 counts. The 40-asset headline includes partner programs/options beyond the disclosed development buckets.
Already approved biosimilars awaiting launch, including geographic filings of the same indication, are excluded. Reference medicine brand names are not represented as Sandoz-owned marketed brands.
The November/April 2025 licensing releases are older than 2026-06 and are used only for provenance/indication, not current phase or milestone timing.

Required curl HEAD checks were attempted, but local DNS resolution failed (curl exit 6, HTTP 000); HTTP status could not be independently confirmed locally. Sources were opened with the web browser tool.

HLX13 code, antibody modality, CTLA-4 target and lead HCC indication are verified in the partner’s May 2025 release, older than 2026-06. It describes an integrated Phase 1/3 trial; a current numeric phase after regulatory streamlining was not re-established, so phase remains null.

Pertuzumab’s item URL is the primary company license release; its reg classification is supported by the EU-submission row in the opened Q3 company presentation mirror. The original Q3 PDF could not be retrieved from the company’s dynamic financial-materials page.
